paragraphs.text: Armadillo is a creature type for cards that depict nocturnal insectivorous mammals with large claws and a body covered in bony plates that live in deserts.

Armadillo has appeared on 3 cards in mono- white , mono- green , and mono- red , respectively. Consequently, they don't have a standard color in which they appear, though this may change in the future.
Hibernation ( Urza's Saga ) was the first card to depict an armadillo in its art. It would much later appear as a type in Outlaws of Thunder Junction on Armored Armadillo and Spinewoods Armadillo .
Dominaria is known to have some armadillos that hibernate in the cold.
There is also a spell on Dominaria known as Armadillo Cloak that grants people armadillo-like armor.

Thunder Junction has two species of Armadillo. The plains are home to armored armadillos that appear to wear smooth, patterned metal over their back and heads. It's not known if this is natural or placed on by other creatures. Kellan compared riding one to a "slow cannonball with legs". . The forests of cacti on the plane are home to the Spinewoods armadillos , which has a green, cacti-like plate on their back and appears to eat the flowers off of cacti. .
Avatar: The Last Airbender features the Tiger-Dillo , a species of animal that is a cross between a tiger and an armadillo. It looks like a tiger with the bony black plates of an armadillo.
